page.overview:
What is River Narg?

The River Narg is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It was originally created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "The White Ship".

The River Narg is a sacred river that flows through the fabled land of Cathuria in the legends of those who live in the Dreamlands. On the green and flowery mountains of Cathuria stand temples of pink marble with silver fountains in their courtyards that flow with the scented and musical waters of the Narg. The river is said to be home to colorful varieties of fish not found outside Cathuria. (: "The White Ship")
